调度器决定哪个就绪任务获得 CPU。周转时间等于完成时刻减到达时刻，响应时间等于首次运行时刻减到达时刻；更早开始不一定意味着更早结束。先来先服务按到达顺序非抢占运行。最短任务优先 SJF 选择当前可用任务中运行时间最短的，并且不抢占；最短剩余时间优先 STCF 允许抢占，总是选择剩余服务时间最短的任务。使用这类策略比较时，要说明如何知道所需运行时间。

轮转调度 RR 让就绪队列中的任务轮流运行，每次最多一个时间片，尚未完成的任务回到队尾。较小时间片可改善首次响应，却增加切换频率；较大时间片可分摊切换开销，却可能延长其他任务首次运行前的等待。平均响应更小或切换占比更低，都不能单独证明某策略适合所有目标。

多级反馈队列 MLFQ 根据已经观察到的执行行为调整优先级，不要求预知准确运行时间。高优先级任务先于低优先级任务执行，同级可轮转；新任务从高优先级开始，用完 CPU 配额后降级。按累计使用量计算配额，可防止任务通过每次在时间片结束前主动让出 CPU 来永久保留高优先级。周期性提升优先级可帮助长期等待的低优先级任务。队列层数、片长、配额和提升间隔都是策略参数。

本练习另行规定一套明确模型，属于自拟教学条件：默认单处理器、独立任务、每个任务只有一个 CPU burst 且无 I/O；题目提供到达时间与服务量。切换消耗的时间不算给任何任务的 CPU 服务。提前完成的任务不消耗剩余时间片。任务恰在片尾到达时，要说明新到任务与被抢占任务谁先入队，平局也要指定顺序。

如果计算切换开销，应写明何时计费，例如只在切换到另一个任务时计费且首次派发免费，并说明切换期间到达任务如何入队；忽略开销时也须明确。可先记录每个任务首次运行与结束时刻，再计算所需指标。设计建议还需要具体目标与约束，如响应上限、开销预算或公平性。一个方案可能满足一个约束，却在另一个指标上更差。题内任务长度和预算是自拟输入，不是实测工作量，生成器标注也不是学生实测难度。

Deterministic single-processor RR or STCF scheduling with independent, single-burst processes and no I/O. Times are integer abstract time units. Initial dispatch and dispatch after an idle interval are free. RR boundary=before/after orders arrivals exactly at a slice end before/after the unfinished process is requeued; earlier waiting processes keep their position. during_switch=tail appends switch-time arrivals to the queue; before_preempted inserts them immediately before the just-preempted process if it is still queued, otherwise at the tail. The next process is selected before switching, and arrivals through the switch end are enqueued before it starts. early_finish_free waives the next different-process switch cost only if the previous process completed in less than a full quantum. Same-process continuation is free. STCF supports zero switch cost only and chooses (remaining time, id), including id-based preemption on equal remaining times. Id comparison is Unicode lexicographic order. switch_count counts adjacent different-process transitions, including free early-finish transitions, but excludes initial/idle dispatch. makespan is final completion measured from time zero, including initial and intermediate idle intervals. Consecutive run intervals for the same process without an intervening switch/idle interval are merged.

Deterministic single-processor RR or STCF scheduling with independent, single-burst processes and no I/O. Times are integer abstract time units. Initial dispatch and dispatch after an idle interval are free. RR boundary=before/after orders arrivals exactly at a slice end before/after the unfinished process is requeued; earlier waiting processes keep their position. during_switch=tail appends switch-time arrivals to the queue; before_preempted inserts them immediately before the just-preempted process if it is still queued, otherwise at the tail. The next process is selected before switching, and arrivals through the switch end are enqueued before it starts. early_finish_free waives the next different-process switch cost only if the previous process completed in less than a full quantum. Same-process continuation is free. STCF supports zero switch cost only and chooses (remaining time, id), including id-based preemption on equal remaining times. Id comparison is Unicode lexicographic order. switch_count counts adjacent different-process transitions, including free early-finish transitions, but excludes initial/idle dispatch. makespan is final completion measured from time zero, including initial and intermediate idle intervals. Consecutive run intervals for the same process without an intervening switch/idle interval are merged.

function.name: mcp__teaching__cpu_schedule_v1
function.description:
Deterministic single-processor RR or STCF scheduling with independent, single-burst processes and no I/O. Times are integer abstract time units. Initial dispatch and dispatch after an idle interval are free. RR boundary=before/after orders arrivals exactly at a slice end before/after the unfinished process is requeued; earlier waiting processes keep their position. during_switch=tail appends switch-time arrivals to the queue; before_preempted inserts them immediately before the just-preempted process if it is still queued, otherwise at the tail. The next process is selected before switching, and arrivals through the switch end are enqueued before it starts. early_finish_free waives the next different-process switch cost only if the previous process completed in less than a full quantum. Same-process continuation is free. STCF supports zero switch cost only and chooses (remaining time, id), including id-based preemption on equal remaining times. Id comparison is Unicode lexicographic order. switch_count counts adjacent different-process transitions, including free early-finish transitions, but excludes initial/idle dispatch. makespan is final completion measured from time zero, including initial and intermediate idle intervals. Consecutive run intervals for the same process without an intervening switch/idle interval are merged.
